verdict: Leads surged and cost per lead dropped — intake conversion now needs attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 20 leads at a cost per lead of $154.39 — a 30% improvement over the prior period, driven by a concentrated push in Google Ads and Local Services. The week-over-week lead volume more than doubled, which is the strongest short-term signal this account has seen. However, 85 opportunities are sitting in your pipeline with zero converted to consultations, pointing to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up — the ads are working; the handoff needs tightening. Conversion tracking on Google Ads is also being repaired, so the Google-side lead count under-reports until that fix is confirmed. Next period, focus shifts to closing the intake loop so the lead volume gains translate into booked consultations.
